contract.completeness: Gate on the per-turn status AND code validity; never on an is_set number alone.
contract.dates: Only date_kind selects which fields are consumed. Ignore stale irrelevant fields; year/month zero means unspecified.
contract.consent: Reset consent_action and corrected_amount after processing. Revision change invalidates prior confirmation.
contract.prompts: Every custom extraction_prompt includes all four required extractor placeholders.
contract.confidence: 0.7 except corrected_amount=0.5 after a correct 350 was discarded at confidence 0.562. Missing correction data must leave proposal incomplete.
contract.reset: Reset numeric extraction fields to a numeric sentinel such as -1 (amount) or 0 (date parts), and per-turn status to absent/pending after consumption. Empty-string numeric resets did not reliably replace the previous typed value in chat.
contract.date_routing: Require customer_intent=proposal AND date_status=complete|vague. Vague may enter clarification processing, but never a bank-write node. Partial must not enter processing; is_set(day) is unsafe.
contract.practice_parameters: The identity digit regex tests four digits; derive its length and DOB numeric order from the actual brief. The chat adapters use practice-calendar semantics and must be parameterized from policy for production.
contract.consent_missing: On any correction clear confirmed_revision and mark proposal_complete=false. Only mark complete after successfully capturing and validating changed fields; a later yes cannot confirm an incomplete revision.

date.name: date_status
date.description: For the current payment-date answer: complete if an exact date expression is finished; vague for an indefinite period; partial if the caller explicitly pauses before completing it; absent if no payment date answer.

date.name: date_kind
date.description: Shape of latest corrected payment date: keyword for today/tomorrow/vague; weekday for ONLY this/next weekday without a numbered day; numbered if a day number is supplied, even with an incidental weekday such as Monday the 26th; none for partial/absent.

date.name: date_keyword
date.description: Only the literal relative meaning today, tomorrow, or vague (including next week, week after next, salary time, end of month). Do not manufacture a concrete date.

date.name: date_weekday
date.description: Weekday named in a weekday-only expression.

date.name: date_relative
date.description: Literal this or next qualifier for a weekday-only expression.

date.name: date_day
date.description: Corrected explicit day of month, including spoken ordinals; 0 if not supplied. The 21st, sorry, the 20th means 20.

date.name: date_month
date.description: Explicit month as 1..12; 0 if not stated. Never infer from system date.

date.name: date_year
date.description: Four-digit year only if explicitly spoken; otherwise 0. Never use system year.

date.name: customer_intent
date.description: Intent of latest relevant speech. A proposed amount/date is proposal, not refusal. A question is question, not confirmation.

amount.name: amount_status
amount.description: complete only if caller finished the amount; partial for trailing fragments or an explicit pause; absent otherwise. Combine a continuation only with the immediately preceding partial amount.

amount.name: amount_value
amount.description: Latest fully spoken corrected payment amount as a decimal number. Four hundred and twenty = 420. A trailing four hundred and... is incomplete and must not count as 400. Omit while partial.

identity_date.name: identity_status
identity_date.description: complete if entire birth day, month and full year have been supplied; partial if unfinished; absent if unrelated.

identity_date.name: identity_date_text
identity_date.description: Transcribe ONLY the birth date answer; preserve spoken component order and numeric ambiguity. Convert word-number components to digits if needed but never swap day/month yourself. A date fragment is not a full date.

identity_digits.name: identity_status
identity_digits.description: complete only once all four phone digits have been supplied. partial for two digits and a pause. Combine only the current unfinished answer, never earlier wrong answers.

identity_digits.name: identity_digits
identity_digits.description: Exactly the four phone digits supplied, preserving leading zero. Convert digit words; omit if fewer than four have been supplied.

consent.name: consent_action
consent.description: Current response to read-back: confirm ONLY an unqualified clear yes to the unchanged proposal. Any amount/date correction is correct even when preceded by yes. No is refuse. Questions, silence or unrelated speech are pending.

consent.name: corrected_amount
consent.description: New amount explicitly requested in the latest correction; omit when no amount correction. Never copy the old read-back amount.

limits: Single functional chat runs, not a triple-run reliability estimate or a full agent simulation.
customer_intent=proposal was observed in date cases; standalone non-proposal intent suite was blocked by HTTP 502 at chat startup.
Date+intent compound gate passed PUB-04; broader retest was interrupted by HTTP 502. Earlier date schema suite passed 7/7 with status-only processing gates.
Numeric sentinel reset verified for amount and consent; no write is authorized by extraction alone.
Consent adapter demonstrates amount correction. Date/product/batch changes need equivalent revision invalidation in the template.
Practice-specific question length, numeric DOB order and calendar interpretation must be supplied from the actual policy.
